Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft + next steps (NovaHealth)

Jordan —

Great to speak earlier today. Per our discovery call, I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to capture milestones, owners, and target close date so we can stay aligned. High-level summary below:

- Target close date (proposed): 2026-05-15
- Key milestones:
  - Security review complete (NovaHealth) — target 2026-04-15 — owner: Jordan
  - Legal review & redlines — target 2026-04-30 — owner: NovaHealth legal / Alicia
  - PO issued / procurement sign-off — target 2026-05-01 — owner: Alicia
  - Integration kickoff (Redwood + NovaHealth eng) — target 2026-05-10 — owner: Soojin
  - Production validation & go-live — target 2026-05-15 — owner: Marissa (CS enable)

Dependencies: security questionnaire in progress, procurement calendar (budget cycle), and access to a staging dataset for perf testing.

Actions requested from you: please confirm owners above, call out any missing dependencies, and let me know if the proposed close date looks realistic given your procurement cycle. I cc'ed Neha (CS) and Soojin (Solutions Eng) so they can flag any onboarding constraints up front.

Attached: 20260305-novahealth-MAP-draft.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll follow up once I have your confirmation and any notes from legal.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

Thanks Marissa — good recap and the MAP is helpful. A couple items from our side: we just started our Q3 budget review and procurement told me the earliest PO approval window is now mid-June (budget reallocation pushed our spend out ~4–6 weeks). That means the proposed May 15 close is optimistic for us.

Proposed change: reforecast target close to 2026-06-20.

Also: our security team is still working through the questionnaire and expect to finish by the end of April. Legal asked for an extra week for redlines after that. I’ve cc'ed Alicia (procurement) to coordinate PO timing.

Can you update the MAP with a reforecast and reprioritize the integration milestone if needed? We’d like to compress the integration work once legal finishes, but procurement timing is the blocker.

—
Jordan

- Security review complete: 2026-04-30 (as you noted) — owner: Jordan
- Legal redlines returned: 2026-05-10 — owner: NovaHealth legal / Alicia
- PO issued: 2026-05-20 — owner: Alicia (procurement)
- Integration kickoff: 2026-05-24 (compressed onboarding) — owner: Soojin
- Go-live: 2026-06-25 — owner: Marissa / CS

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: MAP draft + next steps (NovaHealth)

Forwarding my quick ops notes on the reforecasted MAP:

Marissa — thanks for the update. If the customer closes 6/25, recommend we schedule onboarding kickoff the week of 7/6 to allow for account setup, API keys, and a short perf validation window. To keep the timeline tight:
- Prioritize API surface: tokenization, embedding calls, generation endpoints (leave advanced routing and caching for post-go-live).
- Plan for a 2-week sprint cadence for initial integration and a follow-up validation sprint.
- I’ll coordinate a checklist for staging data & access; likely dependency on NovaHealth security to provide sanitized test data.

Sooj — can you confirm if the team can compress the integration into the proposed dates if legal returns by 5/10? Also flag any additional infra pre-reqs.

—
Neha Kapoor
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
